project_info.title: Trendy chair dance under stage lights

prompt.main_subject: An adult dancer with long brown curly hair and pink highlights, wearing a white short cropped sweatshirt, black leather shorts, and black Martin boots, seated on a glossy black vintage chair while performing a chair dance.
prompt.composition_elements: The dancer and chair are central on a reflective stage floor. A backdrop wall of colored circular lights changes with the rhythm, creating a modern pop stage.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Glossy hair, face fill light, soft side light, contrast, and dappled shadows create rich image layers, clear facial detail, and a trendy cinematic atmosphere.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: Smooth 10-second pacing as stated in the source.
technical_specs.camera: Cinematic camera movement and cutting are requested without a specified path.
technical_specs.audio: Synthesizer music throughout with heavy drum beats; no dialogue or subtitles.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a smooth 10-second vertical 9:16 video with extreme high definition, cinematic camera sense, cinematic image quality, and master-level camera movement and cutting. An adult dancer with long brown curly hair and pink highlights wears a white short cropped sweatshirt, black leather shorts, and black Martin boots. She sits on a glossy black vintage chair and performs a chair dance. The background is a stage wall composed of colored circular lights that change with the rhythm, and the ground is a reflective stage floor. The overall style is trendy and stage-focused, full of modern pop music energy. Use a delicate natural expression, glossy hair, face fill light, soft side light, contrast, dappled light and shadow, rich image layers, clear face, long eyelashes, defined makeup, and a natural cool-white skin tone. Use synthesizer music with heavy drum beats, no dialogue, no subtitles, natural human body structure, smooth stable movement, and no flicker.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, text, logo, distortion, deformation, disfigured face, stiff movements, camera shake, flicker, disproportionate, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
